solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Beware of a dark place

definitions.meaning: ...! is the Latin warning cry 'look out!' once used by British schoolboys
a hollow in a hillside or underground, unlit

explanation.surface: A warning to keep away from somewhere gloomy.
explanation.walkthrough: British schoolboy slang borrowed the Latin imperative, pronounced KAY-vee, to warn that a teacher was coming.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one spelling: a Latin warning cry and an underground hollow.

clue.text: Pressurising old chap about cooked rice

indicators.note: about puts the fellow around the scrambled letters

parts.note: cove is a dated British slang word for a fellow

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or doctored, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An elderly man stands over some prepared rice, pressing someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' turns RICE into ERCI, and COVE goes 'about' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Using force or threats to make someone act describes compelling behaviour.

clue.text: Crime in residential property on island — state's support is needed

parts.note: a villa is a house
NY is the abbreviation for New York state

explanation.surface: An offence at a house on an island, with official backing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'support' is placement: NY sits at the bottom of this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Wicked or criminal behaviour, the conduct of a rogue.

clue.text: Announcement of what's to come before speech

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
diction is one's manner of speaking

explanation.surface: A forecast made ahead of a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A forecast is a statement about future events, so it announces what lies ahead.

clue.text: Strange space in part of stomach

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd
an en is a printer's space

explanation.surface: An odd gap in the gut.
explanation.definitionFit: The first chamber of a ruminant's multi-part digestive organ.

clue.text: Batter on it or batter with it?

definitions.meaning: a chicken leg is often coated in fried batter
a stick to beat a drum with

explanation.walkthrough: 'Batter' is first the cooking coating, then the verb to strike.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word names a cooked fowl's lower leg and a percussionist's beater.

clue.text: Broken crayon vital for one who makes 3s

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so these letters are put back in a new order

explanation.surface: A snapped wax stick is essential for a fortune teller.
explanation.walkthrough: The '3s' are answers to 3 across: predictions.
explanation.definitionFit: A seer claims to see the future and so foretells events.

clue.text: I wish the compiler to be put up in the same place

parts.note: to bid is to wish someone something, as in bid good night

indicators.note: put up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, reversing it

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A setter asks for lodging somewhere familiar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' reverses ME to EM in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin used in footnotes to cite the source just mentioned again, abbreviated ibid.

clue.text: For this temperature one needs shade with noon not cold

indicators.note: with brings in the letter for midday as a replacement
not cold means the letter for cold is dropped in favour of the new one

parts.note: a nicety is a fine shade of difference
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: In heat like this you need somewhere shaded, even at midday.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a temperature in Fahrenheit: a hot day.
explanation.definitionFit: Ninety degrees Fahrenheit is a sweltering reading, when shade is welcome.

clue.text: Devious European to see

parts.note: a see is a bishop's diocese; Ely is a cathedral city and see in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: A shifty continental visitor goes to look around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' looks like a verb, but it is the noun for a bishop's seat: ELY, a cathedral city in eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Slippery like an eel, hence evasive and hard to pin down.

clue.text: In the morning put it back in a leg that's cut

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, marks morning times

indicators.note: in places the turned-round pair inside A and ON

parts.note: on is the leg side in cricket

indicators.note: back tells us the word it is read in the other direction

explanation.surface: Instructions for reattaching something to a severed limb early in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns IT into TI, which goes 'in' A + ON to give ATION. In cricket the leg side is also called the on side.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgical removal of a limb is a cutting off, so the noun cut fits.

clue.text: 'Tea?', with smile causing vexation

parts.note: cha is a British slang word for tea
a grin is a broad smile

explanation.surface: Offering a cuppa with a smirk annoys someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name a feeling of annoyance or mortification at being thwarted.

clue.text: Refreshment break before speech

indicators.note: before puts the pause ahead of the address

parts.note: a rest is a break
an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: Tea and biscuits during an interval before an address.
explanation.definitionFit: Renewal of vigour or restoring to a former state is being refreshed.

clue.text: Waves draw back more than normal

parts.note: surf is breaking waves

indicators.note: back means this word for a drawn game is read in reverse

parts.note: a tie is a drawn match

explanation.surface: The sea's breakers retreat further than usual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns TIE into EIT.
explanation.definitionFit: An excess is an amount beyond what is usual or needed.

clue.text: Naughty modes unveil her

indicators.note: naughty behaviour is disorderly, so these letters misbehave into a new order

explanation.surface: Racy fashions reveal a woman's body.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'her' is the famous armless Greek statue in the Louvre, who is indeed unveiled, being half naked.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun points to a particular female figure: the celebrated marble Aphrodite from Melos.

clue.text: Charmed by armour in dire need? That's not right

indicators.note: dire means dreadful, so these letters are thrown into disorder
that's not tells us one letter for right is dropped from the pool

explanation.surface: Captivated by a suit of mail one urgently requires, though that seems wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'That's not right' removes one R from ARMOUR + NEED; 'dire' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To be smitten with something is to be in love with or captivated by it.

clue.text: Plant that may get involved with motoring organisation to make a man a cycle

indicators.note: get involved means mixed together with the motoring body's letters into a new arrangement

parts.note: the AA is Britain's Automobile Association

explanation.surface: A flower that, joined by a motoring club, turns a man into a bike.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer plus AA rearranges to A MAN A CYCLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A low-growing flower with swept-back petals, often grown as a pot specimen.

clue.text: Cardinal point in eastern doner kebab, for example

indicators.note: in places the compass point inside the meat

parts.note: a doner kebab is made from minced meat
NE, northeast, is a compass point

explanation.surface: A churchman sticks a skewer into his takeaway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' looks like a compass word near 'point', but it is the prelate.
explanation.definitionFit: His Eminence is the formal title of a cardinal of the Roman church.

clue.text: Poet, old character, needs grass mown — may cut back

parts.note: a mark is a written sign or character
hay is grass that has been cut and dried

indicators.note: cut back means the word may is reversed

explanation.surface: A gardening poet's instructions: mow the lawn and prune the hawthorn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut back' reverses MAY (hawthorn blossom) to YAM.
explanation.definitionFit: The Persian astronomer whose Rubaiyat, in FitzGerald's translation, made him a famous versifier.

clue.text: Check what's needed for picnic?

definitions.meaning: a wicker basket for carrying food outdoors

explanation.definitionFit: One word is both a verb meaning to hinder and a lidded basket for alfresco food.

clue.text: Highly-placed ornaments one's ignored in exams

indicators.note: ignored means this letter for one is left out

parts.note: finials are decorative knobs on top of spires or posts
one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Decorations up high are overlooked in examinations.
explanation.definitionFit: Final-year university examinations are known collectively by this plural.

clue.text: Soul to play in a lively manner

parts.note: anima is the Latin and Jungian word for the soul

explanation.surface: Spirit is needed to perform well.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction instructing performers to proceed with animation.

clue.text: Toxin drunken lout put in wine

indicators.note: put in places the scrambled letters inside the word for a wine rack

parts.note: a bin is a cellar rack for wine, and the word labels wines such as Bin 65

indicators.note: drunken describes something staggering about, so these letters lurch out of order

explanation.surface: A poison: a boozy yob slipped it into the wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunken' rearranges LOUT to OTUL, which is 'put in' BIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The poison produced by the bacterium behind botulism, a deadly foodborne illness.

clue.text: Tree's decoration in chest

parts.note: the bo tree is the sacred fig of India, so tree's gives BO'S
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: An ornament on a tree hangs in a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chest' looks like a box but means the breast.
explanation.definitionFit: The breast, a person's front upper torso.

clue.text: Illegal copying of crystal form worn by girl returning to Iowa

indicators.note: worn by means the girl and state carry the crystal shape around them, so it splits to hold them

parts.note: a prism is a geometric form that crystals can take

indicators.note: returning means the word for girl is read backwards

parts.note: gal is an informal word for a girl
IA is the US postal abbreviation for Iowa

explanation.surface: Pirating a crystal design worn by a woman heading back to Iowa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' applies only to the girl, not to the state abbreviation that follows her; 'worn by' means the crystal shape wraps around both.
explanation.definitionFit: Passing off another's work as one's own is literary theft.

clue.text: Captain heading west to find 3

indicators.note: in an across clue, going westward means reading from right to left

parts.note: Captain Nemo commands the Nautilus in Jules Verne's novel

explanation.surface: A sea captain sails west in search of something.
explanation.walkthrough: The '3' refers to the answer to 3 across, PREDICTION.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent is a sign foretelling the future, a kind of forecast.

clue.text: House is damaged by this Prime Minister's promotion, rejected after rebellion

indicators.note: after puts the reversed pair following the word for revolt

parts.note: a rising is an uprising or revolt

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so this pair is read in reverse

parts.note: PM is the abbreviation for Prime Minister
an ad promotes goods

explanation.surface: A premier's advertising campaign is thrown out once a revolt breaks out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns the pair round to make DAMP; 'after' places it behind the revolt. 'House is damaged by this' is a descriptive definition of a building defect.
explanation.definitionFit: Moisture creeping up through walls from the ground harms buildings.

clue.text: King born in joint

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
née, from French, means born, giving a woman's maiden name

explanation.surface: A monarch was born in a particular establishment.
explanation.definitionFit: The hinge in the leg between thigh and shin is a joint.
